name: DOCUMENT_STAMPS
description: This table contains information about stamps added to scanned documents.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the document record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: STAMP_TEXT
columns.description: Contains stamps that have been added to this document.

columns.name: STAMP_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: Contains types of stamps that have been added to this document.

columns.name: STAMP_ADD_USER_ID
columns.description: The user who added a stamp to the document.

columns.name: STAMP_ADD_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: STAMP_ADDED_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant a stamp was added to the document.
